messages:
gina: Heads-up: sketching an onboarding + preset strategy for Private (VPC/on-prem) that separates network ops setup from runtime packaging. Want reactions before I file RFC.

gina: Key idea: ship three onboarding flows that map to customer network ownership and risk appetite — Relay-only (quick), NAT-Passthrough (managed egress + IP pinning), and Full-Peering (BGP/peering + IP sovereignty). Each flow has a concise field checklist.

tejas: Love the separation. Suggest we name them: quickstart, managed-egress, peered. Quickstart = relay to Redwood egress, lowest friction.

tejas: Managed-egress needs a clear contract: customer supplies NAT pool or we allocate ephemeral but provide pinning guarantee for N days. Need legal on SLA for IP churn.

lia: Operational concerns: installer should run a preflight that verifies: route propagation, required NAT gateway rules, DNS resolution to control-plane FQDNs, and KMS connectivity (if customer uses external KMS). Failure modes must output exact remediation steps.

lia: For peered mode we also check: ASN present, route filters configured, and a blackhole detection run. We'll add a quick troubleshooting doc for field.

ops-bot: New ticket created: PRD-5902 "Private onboarding flows + egress contract" -> https://go/repo/PRD-5902 :spiral_notepad:

ravi: UX ask: Console needs to present the "network contract" during tenant onboarding (checkbox + summary of egress behavior). Also show the operator-manifest hash and last applied version.

ravi: For upgrades, require an opt-in staged upgrade per-tenant with ability to pause and resume. Console should surface pending manifest diffs and a one-click rollback.

gina: Example preset (YAML) for managed-egress:
```
preset: managed-egress
mode: passthrough
egress_ip_strategy: pin-for-7d
nat_pool: customer-provided
preflight: [route-check, dns, kms-connectivity]
postflight: [egress-ip-verify, handshake-sanity]
```

tejas: Can we add telemetry points: handshake_time_ms, preflight_fail_reason, egress_ip_change_count. Lia, can you consume those?

lia: Yes. We'll emit as structured events to the control-plane and surface in the Console. Add an alert for egress_ip_change_count > 0 for managed-egress in production.

ravi: Launch criteria proposal:
- M0: Quickstart preset e2e + docs + 1 pilot customer onboarded
- M1: Managed-egress preset + ip-pin tests + console network contract + 3 pilot customers
- M2: Peered preset + security sign-off + field runbook + legal acceptance

gina: Suggested timeline: M0 in 4w, M1 in 10w, M2 TBD after M1 if field signals readiness.

tejas: Owners:
- installer & preflight: lia
- upgrade flow + per-tenant pinning: tejas
- console UX + network contract: ravi
- docs + field runbook: gina

gina: Acceptance tests (high level): preflight passes, egress IP stability for pin window, ability to revert to prior manifest, and a successful end-to-end generation test hitting a customer-provided egress path.

tejas: One caveat: for air-gapped installs we need an offline preflight runner that outputs a signed report. Lia can you add an artifact: preflight-report.json that field can upload to the control plane?

lia: Yup. We'll produce a deterministic report and a signing key for field review. Also include a checklist entry: "manifest signature verified".

ops-bot: PRD-5902 labels updated: +field-onboard +networking +due 2026-06-15

gina: Action items from this thread:
- lia -> preflight runner + telemetry (owner)
- tejas -> per-tenant upgrade + ip-pin design (owner)
- ravi -> console contract UX + rollback UI (owner)
- gina -> draft field runbook + ship pilot invites (owner)

gina: If no objections I'll convert this into a short RFC and assign PRD-5902 owners. React with :white_check_mark: or add comments.

tejas: :white_check_mark:

lia: :white_check_mark: will start sketching preflight schema

ravi: :white_check_mark: will mock UX flows next week

gina: Thanks all. Filing RFC now and pinging the pilot list.
